div.div:
verification depends on products, and on nothing else.
It has no dependency on accounts, because a buyer verifies a product without an account (FR28).
This is the shortest path in the system by design. It is the one page opened by people the project cannot contact and cannot support, so it depends on the smallest number of components.

div.div:
Notation the circle on a stalk is a provided interface — a capability the component offers to the rest of the system. The dashed arrow is a dependency, and it points at the exact function that is needed rather than at the component as a whole.
Component → Django app → views.py. Each function in a box is one view function in that app, and each one is reachable in the interface through a button, a link or a menu entry.
